limitations: Windows and exact Core 0.2.1-rc.3 / NEXT 2.0.20-next / Cordis 4.0.5 only; private APIs need a fresh compatibility regression after host upgrades
Running, maintenance, queued input, unsent upload receipts and foreign ownership still block; original startup owner release has rc9 retained evidence
Real rc10 A/B/C and restart/restore gates plus targeted native recovery/ownership tests are fresh; older shared-host, running-agent and locale supporting reports are explicitly retained baseline
NEXT uses the original runtime and extracted app sources in an unpackaged isolated deployment; Office and packaged directory-transition launcher not accepted
Unknown third-party stores, unmodified hosts, external writers and unmapped image variants are not fully coordinated
Foreign cached registry may require host restart; arbitrary cross-cwd multi-membership and all fork/UI combinations are not claimed
Old terminal payload is cleaned only by the explicit history action; this upgrade does not automatically scrub real historical records
Permanent cleanup removes plugin local content payload, not cloud copies, device backups or forensic traces

audit_fixes.issue: Replaced user file becomes owned after edit
audit_fixes.verification: Identity continuity before tool dispatch, native edit without operation field, no ownership takeover; actual read/edit then B deletion preserves replacement in both hosts.
New PERMANENT/RESTORED terminal journal is a minimal whitelist; native synthetic marker and payload flags absent. Explicit legacy terminal cleanup tested in both real recovery interfaces.

audit_fixes.issue: Unrelated corpus change blocks zero-resource deletion
audit_fixes.verification: A/B0/C0 commit survives unrelated native revision changes; foreign unreadable-event paths skipped in adapter tests; real resources keep global reference checks.

audit_fixes.issue: Preview expires while Delete stays actionable
audit_fixes.verification: Refresh before expiry, submit-time expiry guard, abort cleanup, delayed/stale response tests; actual native UI with mocked plan API and advanced clock sends no expired commit.

audit_fixes.issue: Partial restoration not tracked or retryable
audit_fixes.verification: Preflight before file moves; RESTORING/RESTORE_FAILED retained for retries; actual missing-workspace refusal and explicit ungrouped restore in both hosts.

audit_fixes.issue: Interrupted permanent purge has no completion path
audit_fixes.verification: Real Windows exclusive-file-lock unit fault and resumable purge; both native hosts finish partially removed multi-file payload, clear pending and permit subsequent deletion. Changed files and foreign hardlink aliases rejected.
